title: Normalized coefficient-unit realization and derived pullback
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, and uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For every separated finite-type $k$-scheme $T$, put $B_{n,T}=(R/t^n)_T$, $\widehat R_T=\lim_nB_{n,T}$, and let $M_T=\widehat R_T[0]$ be its derived-complete integral coefficient unit [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Write $q_T$ for rationalization, $\mathcal R_T$ for the strict reduction functor and $\mathcal L_T=R\lim\operatorname{Res}$ for normalized reconstruction [lem-pur-normalized-reconstruction-adjunction-calculus]. Use $J_T$ and its pullback comparison from [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization], $U_T=p_T^*\underline\Omega$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] with exactly the coefficient ring of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], and $T^T_{E,\Omega}=U_T\otimes^L_{E_T^c}-$, the derived extension [def-sfb-derived-extend-to-qlbar] along [def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map]; extension of scalars along $E_T^c\to U_T$ is exact on every such $T$, whose underlying space is noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-flat-coefficient-calculus], so the comparison (Pull) below is defined. Put $F_T=T^T_{E,\Omega}J_Tq_T$.

For a $k$-morphism $h:T\to V$ between such schemes, let $P_h$ be inverse image of strict normalized finite coefficient systems. The finite unit maps $d_{h,n}:Lh_n^*B_{n,V}\xrightarrow{\sim}B_{n,T}$ are multiplication maps; they constitute the canonical actual system morphism $d_{h,\bullet}:P_h\mathcal R_VM_V\to\mathcal R_TM_T$ with coefficient-quotient transitions. Transport this morphism through $\mathcal L_T$, using the normalized reconstruction units/counits, to obtain $\widehat d_h:\widehat Lh^*M_V\xrightarrow{\sim}M_T$, where $\widehat Lh^*$ is completed integral pullback [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. There are canonical unit identifications
$$j_T:J_Tq_TM_T\xrightarrow{\sim}E_T^c,\qquad u_T:F_TM_T\xrightarrow{\sim}U_T.$$
If $c_h:F_T\widehat Lh^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh_\Omega^*F_V$ is the composite of the rationalized integral pullback comparison, the specified $J$ pullback comparison, and the inverse of the derived coefficient/pullback comparison (Pull) [def-sfb-derived-pull-iso], then
$$u_T\circ F_T(\widehat d_h)=e_h\circ Lh_\Omega^*(u_V)\circ c_{h,M_V},$$
where $e_h:Lh_\Omega^*U_V\xrightarrow{\sim}U_T$ is the canonical module-unit pullback. The analogous equation before $T_{E,\Omega}$ holds with $j_T$ and the $E^c$ unit pullback. These equalities hold for the actual reconstructed system map, not merely after finite-level evaluation. They commute with identity morphisms and composition: the finite-level unit multiplications, their reconstructed maps and their images use the canonical derived pullback compositors, and satisfy $e_f\,Lf^*(e_g)\,c_{f,g}=e_{gf}$ for composable morphisms, with the identity comparison giving $e_{\mathrm{id}}=1$.
